name: Cloud of Razors
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 10)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser cloud of razors except it deals 2 slashing damage per round and the damage is considered magic for DR purposes. The damage is also considered silver or cold iron for DR purposes, chosen when the spell is cast.
